notes: Adds a one-time personalized morning, afternoon, or evening welcome when Tater Tube starts, including a watch-or-play suggestion based on recent activity.
Shares privacy-safe activity context across video, live TV, music, Game Center, PC Link, local files, and module use without sending paths, stream URLs, usernames, or credentials.
Adds independent controls for the boot greeting and Tater Picks narration, and stops narration automatically when media, a game, or a PC stream begins.
